svg.text: Your board photo, rotated 180 degrees. Printer connections adapted from the Manta guide.
Port assignments shown are the proposed build configuration; match Klipper to these choices.

Header top -> bottom: DC / GND / PC5

RED = mapped connection / proposed assignment AMBER = optional hardware or ratings still unconfirmed
Probe power must be 5 V. Do not copy the Manta connector positions or its five-pin probe order.
FAN6 and FAN7 are always-on outputs; FAN0-FAN5 are controllable. Fan negative is a switched return.
X Hall -> EBB36 PB6; Y Hall -> EBB36 PB7. Extruder, hotend and toolhead fans also connect to EBB36.
Source: BTT Octopus Pro V1.1 pinout + your actual board photo. Electrical checks and sensor behavior remain pending.

Gray CONTROL return goes to BED-OUT -.
Do not substitute PSU ground for that return.
Wire endpoints mark the connector zone; follow the wires.
The two blue leaders identify the output pair only.
Individual output +/- contacts are not assigned by this photo.
12 AWG: PSU -> DC IN, and heater output leads.
Supplied small two-wire cable: BED-OUT -> CONTROL.
Heater current comes from the MOSFET DC IN supply.
Octopus BED-OUT carries the control signal only.
